name: Christmas Glory from Westminster (1999)
overview: Talented soloists from Andrea Bocelli to Charlotte Church, and the enchanting choir of Westminster Abbey have come together to provide an evening of beautiful music within the walls of Westminster Abbey. Join HRH the Duke of Edinburgh as he introduces Christmas Glory from Westminster touching upon the historical features of the Abbey and memories of his own wedding there. Throughout the program, guests perform Christmas music and recite poetry from the historic Poets Corner in Westminster Abbey.
